description: At the Fuente Dé cable car station after dark, the great limestone wall of the Picos de Europa looms overhead as a vast black massif. The station's lamps glow at the mountain's foot, dwarfed by the sheer cliffs. Stars fill the sky above the peaks, and the valley around the station lies utterly dark and silent.
